note: Triennial election of Lisnaskea Rural District Council, thirty-one divisions, one member each. The Impartial Reporter of 7 May 1936, p. 7, prints the nominations: two contests, Castlebalfour and Lisnaskea, and sixteen Unionists and thirteen Nationalists returned unopposed, named by division. The Unionists won both contests (count on Thursday 4 June; Impartial Reporter, 11 June 1936, p. 7). Filed on 1936-06-03, the county's polling day that year (provisional). Nominated as J. R. Moore (U.) and John Carron (N.) (Impartial Reporter, 7 May 1936, p. 7); the count report prints 'John Moore' and 'John Carson'. Carron is the nomination spelling, also used by the Irish News; the result is as printed. Poll 89.5 per cent (Impartial Reporter, 11 June 1936, p. 5).
